description: Spring PetClinic is a Spring Boot sample application showcasing standard Spring MVC and Spring Data JPA monolithic architecture patterns for veterinary clinic management. The application lifecycle begins at Application Bootstrap, which configures runtime hints and initializes the Spring application context. When incoming HTTP requests arrive, they are processed through the web layer configured by Web Presentation and Localization, which routes requests to either domain-specific controllers such as Owner and Pet Management (handling pet owner profiles, pet details, and visit schedules) or Veterinarian Management (providing paginated vet listings and specialties). Cross-cutting infrastructure concerns like caching and exception testing are managed by Cache Configuration and Diagnostics to optimize database reads via Spring Cache and verify application error handling workflows.

components.name: Owner and Pet Management
components.description: Manages core veterinary clinic business workflows and domain entities for pet owners, registered pets, and clinic visits, including validation and persistence.

components.name: Visit Management and Entity Traversal
components.description: Handles visit registration, linking clinical visit records to specific pets, and provides lookup/traversal mechanisms across owners, pets, and visits.

components.name: Owner Lifecycle and Search Management
components.description: Manages owner discovery, pagination of search results by last name, and processing form submissions for creating and updating owner profiles.

components.name: Owner-Pet Composition and Form Binding
components.description: Coordinates the composition of pets within owner entities, sets web binder security allowances, and handles view model initialization for pet creation and editing.

components.name: Pet Details and Mutation Processing
components.description: Controls pet attribute modification workflows, birth date and pet type association, and validation rules during pet creation and update processing.

components.name: Pet Type Formatting and Metadata Services
components.description: Provides conversion and formatting facilities for pet types between UI text representations and domain models, along with reference data population for web views.

components.name: Veterinarian Specialties Domain
components.description: Models veterinary medical practitioners and their clinical specialty associations within the domain layer.

components_relations.evidence: `VetRepository` methods annotate data retrieval with `@Cacheable("vets")`, resolving at runtime against the JCache/Caffeine cache region configured by `CacheConfiguration.petclinicCacheConfigurationCustomizer()`.

components_relations.relation: Intercepts incoming web requests to apply locale settings

components_relations.relation: Bootstraps and registers domain controllers and repositories

components_relations.relation: Bootstraps and registers veterinarian controllers and repositories

components_relations.relation: Registers web configuration and landing page endpoints

components_relations.relation: Initializes cache subsystem and diagnostic controllers
